_comment: The lint CONFIGURATION lives in the workspace Cargo.toml ([workspace.lints]:
clippy::all = warn, clippy::pedantic = warn, missing_docs = warn, unsafe_code
= deny). This file does not weaken it and must never be used to. It records
the diagnostics that are deliberately left standing, one lint per entry, each
with the reason it was not fixed.
The gate compares observed per-lint counts against this file exactly, so drift
in either direction fails: a new diagnostic fails, and an entry that no longer
fires fails too. The baseline may only shrink deliberately, by editing this
file in the same commit that removes the diagnostic.
max_errors is 0 and is not negotiable. A clippy error is a compile failure.
It is counted separately from warnings because conflating the two is exactly
how a tree with 3 errors was once reported as clean.
